domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrieved: web_search backend was unavailable ("searx: Connection refused") for all queries, and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. No domestic supply record seen — this is an access failure, not a negative finding.
note: Shipment evidence could not be established either way. ImportKey lists the entity name in its India customs index but the free view exposes no records (0 rows seen against a generic 'shipments available' counter), so the existence of a customs file is not proof of any actual export. volza, eximpedia and trademo returned HTTP 403; importgenius served a JavaScript challenge. Search engine was down for the whole session, so no independent corroboration of the claimed HS codes 847150 / 997331 (computer/IT hardware and IT services) was possible. Per Rule 5 this is recorded as 'unknown' — NOT as 'declared, not confirmed' and NOT as 'no traces found', because the absence of visible rows is a paywall artefact rather than evidence of no shipments. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources, not estimated). No CIN/PAN asserted. Recommended next step: paid ImportKey/Volza export pull or GST portal lookup before any verdict; do not treat the company website or catalogue as shipment evidence.
